specs.Compatible Devices: Headphones, MP3 Players, Tablets, Cameras, Cellular Phones

features: ✅ 25W Super Fast Charging: Equipped with advanced charging technology and USB Power Delivery (PD) support, this charger delivers up to 25 W of power to compatible devices, significantly reducing charging time compared to standard adapters.

✅ Wide Compatibility: Works with a broad range of Samsung Galaxy phones and tablets that support fast charging — including popular models from the A, M, F, S and Z series (e.g., Galaxy S23, S24, A54, A35, M35, Z Fold/Flip) and more.
✅ Smart Charging Tech: Built-in safety protections guard against over-current, over-voltage, overheating, and short circuits, keeping your device safe during every charge.
✅ Universal USB-C Port: Uses a USB-C output for reversible, hassle-free cable connection — just plug and charge (USB-C cable not included).
✅ Portable & Travel-Ready: Slim, lightweight design makes it easy to carry in a bag or pocket — perfect for home, office, or travel.
description: Power up your Samsung smartphone or tablet faster and more efficiently with the Prifakt 25W Super Fast Charger Adapter. Designed for Samsung devices supporting 25W Super Fast Charging, this compact USB-C wall charger delivers reliable, high-speed power wherever you go.
